headline: Norwegian Air Affected by Supplier Data Breach Exposing Passenger Details
summary: Norwegian Air reported that passport information and travel details may have been compromised following a data breach at a supplier.
why: Data security breaches at third-party vendors introduce operational risks and potential regulatory liabilities for airlines.

impacts.name: Norwegian Air Shuttle
impacts.why: Vendor data leaks create operational and reputational risks for the airline.
